construction: Independent reference-derived, compile-valid-intended, single-defect overlays. Each overlay contains both editable library files; protected public files are supplied by repo.

controls.defect: An empty allowedTenants set incorrectly grants access to a syntactically valid bound tenant.
controls.public_requirement_clause: Each operation first checks exact membership of the bound tenant in allowedTenants. A missing membership returns unauthorized without collaborator work.
discriminating_test_names: authorized positive and denied precedence with no collaborator calls

controls.defect: Publishes staged stock, revision, and replay ledger before the pending CAS settles, including failed CAS outcomes.
controls.public_requirement_clause: On CAS success only, replace the local state with staged state. CAS false or StoreUnavailable must preserve local state. Busy returns the unchanged pre-operation view.
discriminating_test_names: C20 current and busy view preserve captured state while CAS pending

controls.defect: Fingerprints omit occurredAt, so timestamp-only changes become exact replays.
controls.public_requirement_clause: The event fingerprint is sha256Hex(utf8.encode(jsonEncode([id, sku, delta, occurredAt]))). Do not drop a field.
discriminating_test_names: canonical fingerprint and every content field, duplicates, case sensitivity

controls.defect: Strict UTF8/JSON parse failures reject canonical malformed payloads before calling the trusted verification boundary.
controls.public_requirement_clause: Call verifyCheckpoint on decoded payload bytes before interpreting their JSON content. A false result fails immediately.
discriminating_test_names: C21 verify boundary is called once before malformed payload rejection

controls.defect: Checks Dart string length rather than UTF8 bytes, allowing a multibyte oversized batch with valid effective duplicate-key content.
controls.public_requirement_clause: UTF-8 encoding of the full string must be at most 65,536 bytes. Excess bytes produce invalidBatch without store work.
discriminating_test_names: C22 valid effective JSON exceeds UTF8 bytes but not character limit

controls.defect: Calls the trusted verifier but ignores false, accepting well-formed canonical checkpoint payloads with invalid MACs.
controls.public_requirement_clause: Call verifyCheckpoint on decoded payload bytes. A false result fails immediately. Integrity failure becomes corruptCheckpoint at the processor boundary.
discriminating_test_names: bad MAC, byte tamper, noncanonical outer and base64 reject

controls.defect: Ignores a false CAS verdict and publishes staged state with a success result after a real revision conflict. Pending CAS still keeps the old local state, distinguishing this from N02.
controls.public_requirement_clause: CAS false produces concurrentCommit. Neither failed CAS nor StoreUnavailable updates local state, counts, revision, or durable data. Caller resolves concurrent commit by explicitly restoring and retrying.
discriminating_test_names: scheduled winner, unchanged loser, explicit refresh and retry

controls.defect: Preserves MAC, tenant, domain, and canonical validation but accepts a signed recovery checkpoint whose embedded revision differs from the store record. Allows stale recovery to replace current local state.
controls.public_requirement_clause: Decoded revision equals expectedRevision. Independently decode each checkpoint copy against the bound tenant and record revision. Recovery is redundant data for the same committed revision, never an older revision or historical backup.
discriminating_test_names: invalid record, contradictory valid copies, stale recovery and preservation

fixed_image_qualification.reason: Root owns fixed-image execution; authoring worker does not run Docker or behavioral suites.
